<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves one set of credentials by its `Id`.

The response includes the current password in clear text, a connection string and the attached
SSH public keys, so treat it as a secret. `PasswordCreatedAt` shows when the password was set.
